services.desc: Ride in style through SPI! About Renting an exotic jetcar in South Padre Island, Texas promises an exhilarating and unforgettable experience. Imagine cruising along the scenic coastal roads with the wind in your hair, the sun shining, and the powerful engine roaring beneath you. The combination of luxurious features, sleek design, and high-speed capabilities will inject an extra dose of excitement into your vacation, making it a thrilling adventure that will leave you with lasting memories. Whether you're exploring the island's stunning beaches or enjoying the vibrant nightlife, a jetcar rental adds a touch of glamour and thrill to your South Padre Island getaway. Get ready to enjoy the thrill of self-operated watercraft known as Jetcars, the perfect way to explore the stunning waters of Port Isabel and South Padre Island. Starting from White Sands Marina in Port Isabel, you'll glide towards the breathtaking views beneath the Queen Isabella Bridge, with chances to see dolphins and sea turtles up close!
